model_specification: Phase 28 combined lean vNext: no home_team nuisance; neutralized player-specific I1 rates; all other retained components unchanged
objective: Test whether direct-I2 regularization strength and recency weighting can improve the actual full-I2 target.

30A.method: For each 2022-2025 target season, fit no-home-team direct-I2 model using only PAs before that season and score target-season I2 PA event log loss. Pool chronologically across development seasons.
30A.finalist_rule: Carry baseline plus up to two non-baseline grid points with lowest pooled PA event log loss into Phase 30B. PA screening cannot promote a model.

30B.method: Build full monthly point-in-time walk-forward models for finalists and exact-score full-I2 Under 0.5 with neutralized I1 player rates.
30B.selection_rule: Select on pooled 2022-2025 full-I2 log loss, Brier tie-break; require no material 2026 replication reversal. Baseline remains if challenger advantage is negligible/unstable.

final_calibration_rule: Only after a raw finalist passes Phase 30B, rerun the single final calibration gate separately; calibration may not rescue a raw failure.
